cards.name: DocumentConversionOptions
cards.path: Scripting commands and classes for Adobe Photoshop/DocumentConversionOptions
cards.summary: Abstract base type of the options object passed as the second argument of Document.changeMode(). It has no members of its own in the 27.4 harvest; a script creates one of its subclasses instead: IndexedConversionOptions (to Indexed Color) or BitmapConversionOptions (to Bitmap), which both list it as their superclass.
use_for: knowing which options object to build before a scripted Image > Mode change
typing the options argument of doc.changeMode() for Indexed Color or Bitmap conversions
avoid: never instantiate it directly: create IndexedConversionOptions or BitmapConversionOptions
RGB / CMYK / Grayscale / Lab conversions need no options object; for a profile-controlled CMYK conversion use Document.convertProfile instead
cards.how: Never reached on its own: it is only the declared type of the optional options parameter of Document.changeMode(destinationMode, options). Pass new IndexedConversionOptions() with ChangeMode.INDEXEDCOLOR, or new BitmapConversionOptions() with ChangeMode.BITMAP.

key_members.name: DocumentConversionOptions
key_members.use: no harvested members (extra.members is empty, no COM type matched): set properties on the subclass IndexedConversionOptions or BitmapConversionOptions

gotchas: there is nothing to set on the base class itself; its subclasses carry every option
the options argument of changeMode is optional; left out, Photoshop uses its default conversion settings (unverified which defaults)
Bitmap mode needs a Grayscale document first, as in the UI; changeMode from RGB straight to ChangeMode.BITMAP fails (unverified)
cards.source: ps_api_04 agent (omv + COM typelib harvest + app knowledge)

cards.name: DocumentInfo
cards.path: Scripting commands and classes for Adobe Photoshop/DocumentInfo
cards.summary: The File > File Info metadata of one document: title, author, caption, headline, keywords, copyright status and notice, owner URL, credit, source, location, job name, instructions, urgency, plus read-only EXIF. Values are embedded in the file (IPTC / XMP) on the next save.
use_for: stamping copyright notice, credit and owner URL into delivered JPEGs and PSDs
adding title, caption and keywords for stock-photo or DAM submission
reading EXIF camera data to sort or route images in a batch
carrying job name and instructions through a print or agency pipeline
avoid: custom or non-IPTC fields: write them through XMPMetadata.rawData
metadata for one layer only: use Layer.xmpMetadata
cards.how: app.activeDocument.info (Document.info) returns this object. Assign strings directly; keywords and supplementalCategories take arrays of strings, copyrighted takes a CopyrightedType and urgency an Urgency value.

key_members.name: keywords
key_members.use: array of keyword strings; assign a whole new array

key_members.name: ownerUrl
key_members.use: URL of the copyright / licensing info

key_members.name: urgency
key_members.use: Urgency.NONE, LOW, TWO, THREE, FOUR, NORMAL, SIX, SEVEN, HIGH

key_members.name: exif
key_members.use: read-only EXIF entries of camera files

gotchas: keywords and supplementalCategories are arrays: build a new array and assign it; pushing onto the array you read does not write back (unverified)
exif is read-only and only filled for files that carried EXIF (the harvest says JPEG / digital photos); its shape is an array of [tag, value] pairs (unverified)
copyrighted and urgency take enum values, not strings
nothing reaches disk until the document is saved; Export As / Save for Web can strip metadata depending on their own metadata setting (unverified)
cards.source: ps_api_04 agent (omv + COM typelib harvest + app knowledge)

review.changes: urgency key_member listed 'TWO ... SEVEN', implying a FIVE value; replaced with the harvested enum (NORMAL sits between FOUR and SIX)

cards.name: GalleryBannerOptions
cards.path: Scripting commands and classes for Adobe Photoshop/GalleryBannerOptions
cards.summary: Banner text of the old Web Photo Gallery (site name, photographer, contact info, date, banner font and HTML font size 1-7), set through GalleryOptions.bannerOptions for app.makePhotoGallery(). obsolete: the harvest marks this class 'Deprecated, the make photo gallery method has moved to Bridge', Application.makePhotoGallery is described as DEPRECATED, and the 27.4 menus have no Web Photo Gallery command; expect the call to fail or do nothing (unverified which).
use_for: reading or maintaining legacy CS3-era gallery scripts
avoid: any new web gallery: export images with Export As and lay out the page in HTML instead
cards.how: new GalleryBannerOptions(), fill it, assign it to GalleryOptions.bannerOptions and pass that GalleryOptions to app.makePhotoGallery(inputFolder, outputFolder, options).

key_members.name: siteName
key_members.use: site title (COM default: Adobe Web Photo Gallery)

key_members.name: fontSize
key_members.use: HTML font size 1-7 (COM default 3), not points

gotchas: deprecated API: makePhotoGallery is marked DEPRECATED in the harvest (unverified whether it throws or silently does nothing in 2026)
fontSize is an HTML size step 1-7, not a point size
cards.source: ps_api_04 agent (omv + COM typelib harvest + app knowledge)

cards.name: GalleryCustomColorOptions
cards.path: Scripting commands and classes for Adobe Photoshop/GalleryCustomColorOptions
cards.summary: Colour scheme of the old Web Photo Gallery HTML pages: page background, banner, text, link, active-link and visited-link colours, each an RGBColor, set through GalleryOptions.customColorOptions. obsolete: the harvest marks this class 'Deprecated, the make photo gallery method has moved to Bridge', Application.makePhotoGallery is described as DEPRECATED, and the 27.4 menus have no Web Photo Gallery command; expect the call to fail or do nothing (unverified which).
use_for: reading or maintaining legacy gallery scripts
avoid: styling a web page today: write the CSS yourself; Photoshop no longer builds galleries
cards.how: new GalleryCustomColorOptions(); assign RGBColor objects (for example a SolidColor's rgb) to its six properties, then set it as GalleryOptions.customColorOptions.
gotchas: the properties take RGBColor objects (COM marks them put-by-reference), not hex strings; pass solidColor.rgb
deprecated API, see GalleryOptions
cards.source: ps_api_04 agent (omv + COM typelib harvest + app knowledge)

cards.name: GalleryImagesOptions
cards.path: Scripting commands and classes for Adobe Photoshop/GalleryImagesOptions
cards.summary: Settings for the large per-image pages of the old Web Photo Gallery: resize on/off, pixel dimension and which side to constrain, JPEG quality 0-12, border, numeric links, and which File Info text (file name, caption, credits, title, copyright) to print under each image. obsolete: the harvest marks this class 'Deprecated, the make photo gallery method has moved to Bridge', Application.makePhotoGallery is described as DEPRECATED, and the 27.4 menus have no Web Photo Gallery command; expect the call to fail or do nothing (unverified which).
use_for: reading or maintaining legacy gallery scripts
avoid: batch-resizing images for the web today: Image Processor / Export As or a Document.resizeImage script
cards.how: new GalleryImagesOptions(), then GalleryOptions.imagesOptions = it.
gotchas: imageQuality uses the old 0-12 JPEG scale, not 0-100
deprecated API, see GalleryOptions
cards.source: ps_api_04 agent (omv + COM typelib harvest + app knowledge)

cards.name: GalleryOptions
cards.path: Scripting commands and classes for Adobe Photoshop/GalleryOptions
cards.summary: Top-level options for app.makePhotoGallery(): layout style (COM default 'Centered Frame 1 - Basic'), e-mail address, .htm vs .html, UTF-8, sub-folder scan, size attributes, metadata, and the five nested option objects (banner, images, thumbnails, colours, security). obsolete: the harvest marks this class 'Deprecated, the make photo gallery method has moved to Bridge', Application.makePhotoGallery is described as DEPRECATED, and the 27.4 menus have no Web Photo Gallery command; expect the call to fail or do nothing (unverified which).
use_for: reading or maintaining legacy Web Photo Gallery scripts
avoid: new web galleries or proof sites: export images with Export As and build the page outside Photoshop
cards.how: new GalleryOptions(); set its strings / booleans and nested option objects, then app.makePhotoGallery(inputFolder, outputFolder, options).

key_members.name: includeSubFolders
key_members.use: scan sub-folders of the input folder

key_members.name: addSizeAttributes
key_members.use: write width / height attributes on img tags

key_members.name: preserveAllMetadata
key_members.use: keep all metadata in the JPEGs

gotchas: the gallery templates (layoutStyle names) shipped with old Photoshop versions; none are expected in 2026 (unverified)
deprecated: makePhotoGallery is marked DEPRECATED in the harvest
cards.source: ps_api_04 agent (omv + COM typelib harvest + app knowledge)

cards.name: GallerySecurityOptions
cards.path: Scripting commands and classes for Adobe Photoshop/GallerySecurityOptions
cards.summary: Watermark ('security') text the old Web Photo Gallery stamped over each image: which text (custom, file name, copyright, caption, credit, title), font, size, colour, opacity, position and rotation. obsolete: the harvest marks this class 'Deprecated, the make photo gallery method has moved to Bridge', Application.makePhotoGallery is described as DEPRECATED, and the 27.4 menus have no Web Photo Gallery command; expect the call to fail or do nothing (unverified which).
use_for: reading or maintaining legacy gallery scripts
avoid: watermarking exports today: add a text or logo layer, lower its opacity, and export; or record an action
cards.how: new GallerySecurityOptions(), then GalleryOptions.securityOptions = it.

key_members.name: content
key_members.use: GallerySecurityType: NONE, CUSTOMTEXT, FILENAME, COPYRIGHT, CAPTION, CREDIT, TITLE

key_members.name: textPosition
key_members.use: GallerySecurityTextPositionType: CENTERED, UPPERLEFT, LOWERLEFT, UPPERRIGHT, LOWERRIGHT

key_members.name: textRotate
key_members.use: GallerySecurityTextRotateType: ZERO, CLOCKWISE45, CLOCKWISE90, COUNTERCLOCKWISE45, COUNTERCLOCKWISE90

gotchas: content defaults to no watermark (COM: NoSecurity); text is used only with GallerySecurityType.CUSTOMTEXT
deprecated API, see GalleryOptions
cards.source: ps_api_04 agent (omv + COM typelib harvest + app knowledge)

cards.name: GalleryThumbnailOptions
cards.path: Scripting commands and classes for Adobe Photoshop/GalleryThumbnailOptions
cards.summary: Thumbnail index page of the old Web Photo Gallery: thumbnail size preset or pixel dimension, grid columns and rows, border, and which labels (file name, caption, credits, title, copyright) to show. obsolete: the harvest marks this class 'Deprecated, the make photo gallery method has moved to Bridge', Application.makePhotoGallery is described as DEPRECATED, and the 27.4 menus have no Web Photo Gallery command; expect the call to fail or do nothing (unverified which).
use_for: reading or maintaining legacy gallery scripts
avoid: contact sheets today: File > Automate > Contact Sheet II (a shipped script) or a Bridge / Lightroom export
cards.how: new GalleryThumbnailOptions(), then GalleryOptions.thumbnailOptions = it.
gotchas: dimension presumably applies only with size = GalleryThumbSizeType.CUSTOM (unverified)
deprecated API, see GalleryOptions
cards.source: ps_api_04 agent (omv + COM typelib harvest + app knowledge)

cards.name: HistoryState
cards.path: Scripting commands and classes for Adobe Photoshop/HistoryState
cards.summary: One entry of a document's History panel, a recorded step or a snapshot. A script reads its name, checks whether it is a snapshot, and jumps back to it by assigning it to Document.activeHistoryState; it can also be the History Brush source or the source of Selection.fill().
use_for: reverting to a clean state after rendering each variant in a batch script
before / after comparisons by switching states
restoring part of an image: fill a selection from an earlier state
setting the History Brush source for a scripted touch-up
avoid: undoing a whole script in one step: wrap it in Document.suspendHistory
keeping versions after the file closes: history is lost on close; save copies or use layer comps
cards.how: app.activeDocument.historyStates[i] or historyStates.getByName(name); the current one is Document.activeHistoryState and the History Brush source is Document.activeHistoryBrushSource. Assigning a state to activeHistoryState is the same as clicking it in the History panel.

key_members.name: name
key_members.use: label shown in the History panel (command name or snapshot name)

key_members.name: snapshot
key_members.use: true for a snapshot at the top of the panel

gotchas: every member is read-only: states cannot be renamed or deleted through this class
state names are localized command names ('Open' only in an English UI): match by index or by a snapshot you named (unverified for every locale)
the list is capped by Preferences.numberOfHistoryStates; old states drop off and references to them become invalid (unverified)
after jumping back, running any command discards the later states unless Preferences.nonLinearHistory is on
there is no DOM method to create a snapshot; it takes an Action Manager 'make snapshot' call (unverified)
cards.source: ps_api_04 agent (omv + COM typelib harvest + app knowledge)

cards.name: IndexedConversionOptions
cards.path: Scripting commands and classes for Adobe Photoshop/IndexedConversionOptions
cards.summary: Settings for a scripted Image > Mode > Indexed Color: palette type, number of colours, forced colours, transparency, dither type and amount, exact-colour protection and matte. Passed to doc.changeMode(ChangeMode.INDEXEDCOLOR, options); the result is a single-layer image limited to a colour table of at most 256 colours, with optional dither noise.
use_for: GIF or PNG-8 style limited-palette graphics and icons
retro, pixel-art or posterized 8-bit looks with visible dither
reducing colours before screen-print or embroidery previews
web-safe or system-palette conversions for legacy targets
avoid: a layered master you still need to edit: convert a duplicate, indexed mode keeps a single layer
photographic web output: Export As PNG-24 / JPEG keeps full colour
cards.how: var o = new IndexedConversionOptions(); set palette (PaletteType), colors, dither (DitherType) and the rest, then app.activeDocument.changeMode(ChangeMode.INDEXEDCOLOR, o). The harvested description says it converts an RGB image.

key_members.name: palette
key_members.use: PaletteType: EXACT, MACOSPALETTE, WINDOWSPALETTE, WEBPALETTE, UNIFORM, LOCALPERCEPTUAL, LOCALSELECTIVE, LOCALADAPTIVE, MASTERPERCEPTUAL, MASTERSELECTIVE, MASTERADAPTIVE, PREVIOUSPALETTE

key_members.name: colors
key_members.use: number of colours in the table; settable only for some palette types

key_members.name: forced
key_members.use: ForcedColors to force in: NONE, BLACKWHITE, PRIMARIES, WEB

key_members.name: preserveExactColors
key_members.use: keep colours already in the table free of dither; diffusion only

key_members.name: matte
key_members.use: MatteType to fill anti-aliased edges against transparency: NONE, FOREGROUND, BACKGROUND, WHITE, BLACK, SEMIGRAY, NETSCAPE

gotchas: PaletteType.EXACT works only when the image already has 256 colours or fewer (unverified error text)
colors is ignored or rejected for fixed palettes such as EXACT, the system palettes and WEBPALETTE (the harvest says it is settable only for some palette types)
ditherAmount and preserveExactColors apply only when dither = DitherType.DIFFUSION
the source should be 8-bit RGB or Grayscale; Indexed Color is unavailable for 16/32-bit documents (unverified error when scripted)
indexed mode leaves one layer and blocks most filters and adjustments: convert last, on a copy
cards.source: ps_api_04 agent (omv + COM typelib harvest + app knowledge)

review.changes: removed equivalents.AI ExportOptionsGIF: it writes a GIF file at export time, while this class changes the document's mode in place (AI's own ExportOptionsGIF card maps to PS ExportOptionsSaveForWeb); CDR StructPaletteOptions kept

cards.name: Layer
cards.path: Scripting commands and classes for Adobe Photoshop/Layer
cards.summary: The shared base of ArtLayer and LayerSet: what every entry in the Layers panel has (name, visibility, opacity, blend mode, lock, bounds, links, stacking order, translate / rotate / resize, duplicate, delete). doc.layers and doc.activeLayer return objects of this family; typename says whether it is an ArtLayer or a LayerSet group.
use_for: renaming, hiding and restacking layers in template automation
setting opacity and blend mode of a texture, overlay or shadow layer
reading bounds to centre or align a logo or product on the canvas
scaling and rotating a placed asset; duplicating a layer for variants
avoid: pixel / text / adjustment work (filters, kind, textItem): use the ArtLayer object
walking children of a group: use LayerSet.layers
cards.how: app.activeDocument.layers[i], doc.layers.getByName(name), doc.activeLayer, or a LayerSet's layers. Each object is really an ArtLayer or a LayerSet; these members work on both. The harvest found no COM interface named Layer: COM / VBScript callers get ArtLayer or LayerSet objects.

key_members.name: typename
key_members.use: "ArtLayer" or "LayerSet": branch on it before kind-specific calls

key_members.name: blendMode
key_members.use: BlendMode value: NORMAL, MULTIPLY, SCREEN, OVERLAY, PASSTHROUGH (groups) ...

key_members.name: bounds
key_members.use: [left, top, right, bottom] UnitValues, including layer effects

key_members.name: boundsNoEffects
key_members.use: the same rectangle without layer-style effects

key_members.name: id
key_members.use: unique layer ID; key for Action Manager references

key_members.name: itemIndex
key_members.use: Photoshop's own index (groups not counted), as Action Manager uses

key_members.name: rotate
key_members.use: rotate by degrees around an AnchorPosition (default MIDDLECENTER)

key_members.name: resize
key_members.use: scale by percent horizontal / vertical around an anchor

key_members.name: move
key_members.use: restack relative to another layer: ElementPlacement.PLACEBEFORE, PLACEAFTER, PLACEATEND

key_members.name: duplicate
key_members.use: copy the layer, optionally placed relative to another object

gotchas: the harvested description of bounds is wrong (it talks about layer sets); it returns [l, t, r, b] UnitValues in the current ruler units: set app.preferences.rulerUnits = Units.PIXELS or use .as("px")
a Background layer cannot be moved, rotated, made transparent or restacked; make it a normal layer first with ArtLayer.isBackgroundLayer = false
resize / rotate on a plain pixel layer resamples each time, so repeated scaling softens it; convert to a smart object first for repeated transforms

the omv marks duplicate's arguments as required, while the COM ArtLayer interface marks Duplicate's RelativeObject / InsertionLocation optional (there is no COM Layer interface); layer.duplicate() with no arguments is common (unverified on 27.4)
moveToEnd has no harvested description ('...'); it presumably moves the layer to the bottom of the given LayerSet (unverified)
cards.source: ps_api_04 agent (omv + COM typelib harvest + app knowledge)

review.changes: duplicate gotcha credited 'the COM type library' although the harvest has no COM Layer interface; reworded to the COM ArtLayer.Duplicate signature it actually comes from

cards.name: LayerComp
cards.path: Scripting commands and classes for Adobe Photoshop/LayerComp
cards.summary: A saved state in the Layer Comps panel that records, per layer, visibility, position and appearance (layer style), so one PSD can hold several layouts or variants. A script applies a comp to switch the document to it, recaptures it after edits, or removes it.
use_for: exporting several layout variants (sizes, colourways, languages) from one PSD
presenting design options to a client from a single file
app or web mockups with alternate screens
avoid: variants that differ in text or pixel content: comps do not record those; keep each version on its own layer
one file per comp without code: File > Export > Layer Comps to Files (a shipped script)
cards.how: app.activeDocument.layerComps[i] or layerComps.getByName(name); create one with doc.layerComps.add(name, comment, appearance, position, visibility). apply() puts the document's layers into the comp's recorded state.

key_members.name: selected
key_members.use: read-only: the comp is selected in the panel

key_members.name: apply
key_members.use: switch the document to this comp

key_members.name: recapture
key_members.use: overwrite the comp with the current layer state

key_members.name: resetFromComp
key_members.use: described as 'resets the layer comp state to the document state'

gotchas: visibility, position and appearance are 'what this comp records' flags (COM: 'use layer visibility'); the omv text for visibility ('the layer comp is visible') is misleading
recapture() overwrites the comp with whatever the layers show now: apply the comp first if you only meant to refresh it
editing a layer's pixels or text changes it in every comp
the omv's add / remove / removeAll are missing from the COM type library, which has Delete and ChildLayerCompState instead (harvest diff); create comps through the LayerComps collection
what resetFromComp does in UI terms is unclear (unverified)
cards.source: ps_api_04 agent (omv + COM typelib harvest + app knowledge)

cards.name: LayerSet
cards.path: Scripting commands and classes for Adobe Photoshop/LayerSet
cards.summary: A layer group (folder in the Layers panel) holding ArtLayers and nested LayerSets. It inherits everything from Layer (name, opacity, blend mode, move, translate ...) and adds its children (layers, artLayers, layerSets), the channels it affects, and merge() to flatten the group into one ArtLayer.
use_for: organising generated layers into named groups (Logo, Copy, Background) in a template
moving, hiding or fading a whole lockup at once
recursively walking a PSD to find layers by name or kind
merging a finished group before export
avoid: looking for pixel or text members on a group: they live on its ArtLayer children
flattening the whole document: use Document.flatten / mergeVisibleLayers
cards.how: doc.layerSets[i], doc.layerSets.getByName(name), or any entry of doc.layers whose typename is "LayerSet". Create a group with doc.layerSets.add(), or nest one with group.layerSets.add().

key_members.name: layers
key_members.use: all children (ArtLayers and LayerSets) in panel order, index 0 = top

key_members.name: layerSets
key_members.use: only the nested groups; .add() creates a nested group

key_members.name: merge
key_members.use: merge the group, returns the new ArtLayer

key_members.name: enabledChannels
key_members.use: component channels the group affects (Advanced Blending channels)

key_members.name: add
key_members.use: listed by the omv on the class itself; create groups via doc.layerSets.add() instead

key_members.name: parent
key_members.use: the Document or the enclosing LayerSet

gotchas: doc.artLayers lists only top-level art layers: recurse through each LayerSet's layers to reach every layer
add is omv-only (missing from the COM type library per the harvest diff); use the LayerSets collection's add()
a new group's blend mode is BlendMode.PASSTHROUGH; setting NORMAL isolates its children's blend modes
merge() returns the new ArtLayer and the group is gone; hidden children are discarded (unverified)
enabledChannels must be a list of component channels (harvest), not alpha channels
cards.source: ps_api_04 agent (omv + COM typelib harvest + app knowledge)

cards.name: MeasurementLog
cards.path: Scripting commands and classes for Adobe Photoshop/MeasurementLog
cards.summary: The Measurement Log panel (Window > Measurement Log): the table of rows recorded by Image > Analysis > Record Measurements. A script exports rows to a file or deletes them; rows are added with Document.recordMeasurements().
use_for: batch-measuring areas, perimeters or counts across product, scan or scientific images
exporting selection dimensions for a QA or print-spec report
avoid: simple width / height of a layer or selection: read Layer.bounds or Selection.bounds instead
cards.how: app.measurementLog (an Application member, not per document). exportMeasurements(file, range, dataPoints) writes rows; deleteMeasurements(range) removes them. range is MeasurementRange.ALLMEASUREMENTS or ACTIVEMEASUREMENTS.

key_members.name: exportMeasurements
key_members.use: write rows to a file; optional range and dataPoints filter the rows / columns

gotchas: exportMeasurements without a file opens a Save dialog (per the harvest), which blocks an unattended script: always pass a File
the default range is the selected rows, which may be none in a script: pass MeasurementRange.ALLMEASUREMENTS
the log belongs to the Application, so rows recorded from several documents mix (unverified)
values follow the document's MeasurementScale; set it before recording
the exported file is comma-separated text (unverified)
cards.source: ps_api_04 agent (omv + COM typelib harvest + app knowledge)

cards.name: MeasurementScale
cards.path: Scripting commands and classes for Adobe Photoshop/MeasurementScale
cards.summary: The document's measurement scale (Image > Analysis > Set Measurement Scale): how many pixels (pixelLength) equal how many logical units (logicalLength, labelled by logicalUnits), so Record Measurements and the Ruler tool report real-world sizes.
use_for: measuring real-world sizes on scanned plans, maps or product photos
quantifying areas on scanned proofs or microscope images
avoid: changing print size or resolution: that is Document.resizeImage; the scale only relabels measurements
cards.how: app.activeDocument.measurementScale; set pixelLength, logicalLength and logicalUnits.
gotchas: it never resamples or changes resolution; only measurement readouts change
logicalUnits is a free text label (harvested type string), not a Units enum value
whether setting name saves a reusable scale preset is unverified
cards.source: ps_api_04 agent (omv + COM typelib harvest + app knowledge)

review.changes: summary stated an invented scale (236 px = 2 cm) as if it were data; replaced with the three members that define it

cards.name: PicturePackageOptions
cards.path: Scripting commands and classes for Adobe Photoshop/PicturePackageOptions
cards.summary: Options for app.makePicturePackage(): the package layout (several copies of photos on one sheet, like passport or wallet prints), resolution, colour mode, flatten, and label text (content, custom text, font, size, colour, opacity, position, rotation). The DOM still lists it, but the 27.4 menu harvest has no Picture Package command (the command appears to have been dropped from Photoshop; unverified), so the call is not expected to work (unverified).
use_for: reading legacy scripts that built passport / ID photo sheets
avoid: photo sheets today: duplicate and translate layers on a print-size canvas with a script, or lay them out in InDesign
cards.how: new PicturePackageOptions(), then app.makePicturePackage(inputFiles, options) with an array of File objects.

key_members.name: mode
key_members.use: NewDocumentMode: GRAYSCALE, RGB, CMYK, LAB, BITMAP

key_members.name: content
key_members.use: PicturePackageTextType label: NONE, USER, FILENAME, COPYRIGHT, CAPTION, CREDIT, ORIGIN

gotchas: no Picture Package command exists in the 27.4 menus (harvest), so makePicturePackage is expected to fail (unverified)
layout names referred to the old Layouts preset folder, which current installs do not ship (unverified)
the text members reuse the Web Photo Gallery 'security text' enums
cards.source: ps_api_04 agent (omv + COM typelib harvest + app knowledge)

review.changes: summary asserted the feature 'left Photoshop after CS3', a version fact not in the batch; reworded as unverified

cards.name: Preferences
cards.path: Scripting commands and classes for Adobe Photoshop/Preferences
cards.summary: The scriptable part of Edit > Preferences: app-wide settings such as ruler and type units (which also set the unit every DOM number is read and written in), resampling method, history depth and history log, file-saving behaviour, grid / guide style, cache levels and RAM use.
use_for: forcing pixel units at the start of every layout script, then restoring the user's units
choosing the default resampling method for scripted resizes
raising history depth or turning on the history log for audit trails
standardising grid and guide settings on a studio machine
avoid: per-document settings (resolution, colour profile, mode): those live on the Document
leaving preferences changed after a script: always restore them
cards.how: app.preferences (Application.preferences). Read a value, store it, set the new one, and restore it in a finally block.

key_members.name: rulerUnits
key_members.use: Units the DOM uses for every length: PIXELS, INCHES, CM, MM, POINTS, PICAS, PERCENT

key_members.name: typeUnits
key_members.use: TypeUnits for type sizes: PIXELS, MM, POINTS

key_members.name: pointSize
key_members.use: PointType: PostScript (72 pt/in) or traditional points

key_members.name: useHistoryLog
key_members.use: turn the history log on / off

key_members.name: saveLogItemsFile
key_members.use: log file when saving to a text file

key_members.name: editLogItems
key_members.use: EditLogItemsType: how detailed the log is

key_members.name: maximizeCompatibility
key_members.use: QueryStateType for the PSD Maximize Compatibility question

key_members.name: maxRAMuse
key_members.use: max percent of RAM for Photoshop

gotchas: preferences are global and persist after the script ends: save rulerUnits / typeUnits and restore them in a finally block
rulerUnits changes the unit of every number the DOM takes or returns (bounds, translate, selection points)
textFontSize, iconPreview, fullSizePreview, macOSThumbnail, windowsThumbnail and appendExtension exist only in the ExtendScript DOM, not the COM type library (harvest diff)
maxRAMuse, imageCacheLevels and plug-in folder changes take effect only after a restart (unverified)
several members date from old versions (pixelDoubling, useVideoAlpha, colorChannelsInColor) and may have no visible effect in 2026 (unverified)
cards.source: ps_api_04 agent (omv + COM typelib harvest + app knowledge)

cards.name: PresentationOptions
cards.path: Scripting commands and classes for Adobe Photoshop/PresentationOptions
cards.summary: Options for app.makePDFPresentation() (File > Automate > PDF Presentation, present in the 27.4 menus): a full-screen presentation or a plain multi-page PDF, auto-advance and interval (1-60 s), looping, transition effect, magnification, file-name captions, and the PDFSaveOptions used to write the file.
use_for: one-PDF portfolio or client proof from a folder of images
self-running full-screen slideshow PDF for a kiosk or pitch
a multi-page PDF of design variations for review
avoid: documents with real layout (captions, grids, body text): build them in InDesign or on Illustrator artboards
variants of one layered PSD: File > Export > Layer Comps to PDF
cards.how: var o = new PresentationOptions(); set it, then app.makePDFPresentation(inputFiles, outputFile, o) where inputFiles is an array of File objects.

key_members.name: presentation
key_members.use: true = full-screen presentation, false = multi-page document

key_members.name: interval
key_members.use: seconds per slide 1-60, only with autoAdvance

key_members.name: transition
key_members.use: TransitionType: DISSOLVE, WIPELEFT, BOXIN, RANDOM, NONE ...

key_members.name: PDFFileOptions
key_members.use: a PDFSaveOptions controlling compression and compatibility

gotchas: PDFFileOptions is upper-case 'PDF' (case-sensitive name)
interval is ignored unless autoAdvance is true
transitions only play in viewers that honour full-screen PDF transitions (unverified)
inputFiles must be File objects; a Folder is not accepted (unverified)
cards.source: ps_api_04 agent (omv + COM typelib harvest + app knowledge)

cards.name: Selection
cards.path: Scripting commands and classes for Adobe Photoshop/Selection
cards.summary: The active pixel selection (marching ants) of a document. A script makes it (polygon select, selectAll, load from a channel), changes it (feather, expand, contract, smooth, grow, similar, border, invert), uses it (fill, stroke, copy, cut, clear, store to a channel, make a work path), and can move or scale either the selected pixels or only the outline.
use_for: colour washes, vignettes and frames on a defined region (fill / stroke / selectBorder)
isolating a product area to copy into a template
saving masks as alpha channels for later reuse
turning a selection into a path for a vector mask or clipping path
avoid: subject / sky masks: those are Select Subject / Select Sky menu commands or Action Manager, not this class
destructive cuts on a master: convert the selection to a layer mask instead
cards.how: app.activeDocument.selection (Document.selection). select(points, type, feather, antiAlias) takes an array of [x, y] corners; SelectionType.REPLACE, EXTEND, DIMINISH or INTERSECT combines it with the existing selection.

key_members.name: select
key_members.use: select a polygon from [[x, y], ...] corners

key_members.name: bounds
key_members.use: bounding box [l, t, r, b]; throws when nothing is selected

key_members.name: solid
key_members.use: true when the selection is a plain rectangle

key_members.name: feather
key_members.use: soften the edge by a radius

key_members.name: selectBorder
key_members.use: keep only a band of the given width along the edge

key_members.name: fill
key_members.use: fill with a SolidColor or HistoryState, blend mode and opacity

key_members.name: stroke
key_members.use: stroke with a colour, width and StrokeLocation INSIDE / CENTER / OUTSIDE

key_members.name: makeWorkPath
key_members.use: convert to a work path with a tolerance

key_members.name: translateBoundary
key_members.use: move only the outline, not the pixels

gotchas: reading bounds with no active selection throws: wrap it in try/catch to test whether anything is selected
select() corners follow the ruler units (unverified); set app.preferences.rulerUnits = Units.PIXELS first
translate / rotate / resize move or scale the selected pixels; translateBoundary / rotateBoundary / resizeBoundary change only the outline
fill, stroke, cut and clear act on the active layer: they fail on a locked layer or a LayerSet (unverified error text)
store() needs an existing Channel: create it with doc.channels.add() first
cards.source: ps_api_04 agent (omv + COM typelib harvest + app knowledge)

cards.name: TextFont
cards.path: Scripting commands and classes for Adobe Photoshop/TextFont
cards.summary: One installed font as Photoshop sees it: display name, PostScript name, family and style, all read-only. Read from app.fonts; its postScriptName is the string TextItem.font expects.
use_for: setting a brand font on text layers by family and style
checking that a template's fonts are installed before a batch run
building a font list or specimen sheet
avoid: changing the font of part of a text layer: TextItem.font applies to the whole layer; per-range styling needs Action Manager
cards.how: app.fonts[i] or app.fonts.getByName(name) (TextFonts collection); loop app.fonts to match family + style, then assign postScriptName to a layer's textItem.font.
gotchas: TextItem.font needs the PostScript name, not the display name; a wrong name falls back to a substitute font or throws (unverified which)
app.fonts holds every installed font (often thousands): loop once and cache what you need
whether getByName matches the display name or the PostScript name is unverified: compare postScriptName in a loop when it matters
Adobe Fonts that are not activated are not listed (unverified)
cards.source: ps_api_04 agent (omv + COM typelib harvest + app knowledge)

review.changes: removed equivalents.CDR FontList: it is the list of installed font names, the counterpart of the TextFonts collection (ps_api_02 already maps it there); CorelDRAW has no single-font object; AI TextFont kept

cards.name: TextItem
cards.path: Scripting commands and classes for Adobe Photoshop/TextItem
cards.summary: The text of a type layer (artLayer.textItem): its contents plus every character and paragraph setting that applies to the whole layer (font, size, colour, tracking, leading, scaling, case, faux styles, anti-aliasing, alignment, indents, hyphenation, justification spacing, point vs paragraph box, warp), and convertToShape() / createPath() to turn it into vectors.
use_for: poster and banner headlines filled from data (localisation, prices, dates)
personalised certificates, name cards and badges
arc or flag warped titles for badges and labels
converting a headline to a shape layer for logo work
avoid: mixed styling inside one layer (one bold word): every property here hits the whole layer; use Action Manager text style ranges or separate layers
long multi-style body copy: InDesign or Illustrator handle per-character styles and threading
cards.how: Make a text layer with var l = doc.artLayers.add(); l.kind = LayerKind.TEXT; then l.textItem. On an existing layer, textItem is valid only when its kind is LayerKind.TEXT.

key_members.name: contents
key_members.use: the text; use \r for a new paragraph

key_members.name: size
key_members.use: font size, a UnitValue / number in type units

key_members.name: justification
key_members.use: Justification: LEFT, CENTER, RIGHT, LEFTJUSTIFIED ... FULLYJUSTIFIED

key_members.name: capitalization
key_members.use: Case: normal / all caps / small caps

key_members.name: antiAliasMethod
key_members.use: AntiAlias: NONE, SHARP, CRISP, STRONG, SMOOTH

key_members.name: warpStyle
key_members.use: WarpStyle: ARC, ARCH, BULGE, FLAG, WAVE, FISH, RISE, SQUEEZE, TWIST ...

key_members.name: convertToShape
key_members.use: turn the text layer into a shape layer

key_members.name: createPath
key_members.use: make a work path from the letter outlines

gotchas: every property applies to the whole layer; there is no per-character API in the DOM
font takes the PostScript name; a display name like "Montserrat Bold" does not match
width / height work only for paragraph text: set kind = TextType.PARAGRAPHTEXT first
position is the text origin (first baseline for point text), not the top-left of the bounds; align with the layer's bounds instead
after a Free Transform scale, size reports the untransformed size (unverified on 27.4)
the omv spells the hanging punctuation member hangingPuntuation; COM calls it HangingPunctuation (harvest diff)
convertToShape is one-way: the text is no longer editable
cards.source: ps_api_04 agent (omv + COM typelib harvest + app knowledge)

review.changes: example set position from doc.width.as('px') but position is read in the current ruler units; added app.preferences.rulerUnits = Units.PIXELS as the first line

cards.name: XMPMetadata
cards.path: Scripting commands and classes for Adobe Photoshop/XMPMetadata
cards.summary: The raw XMP packet (an XML string) attached to a document (doc.xmpMetadata) or to one layer (layer.xmpMetadata). Reading or replacing rawData reaches any metadata namespace (Dublin Core, rights, Camera Raw settings, custom fields), beyond what DocumentInfo exposes.
use_for: auditing or copying rights and licensing metadata across a batch
tagging documents or layers with pipeline IDs (job, version, source) that travel inside the PSD
backing up and restoring Camera Raw settings
writing custom namespaces that File Info cannot show
avoid: plain title / author / keywords / copyright: DocumentInfo is simpler and safer
cards.how: app.activeDocument.xmpMetadata.rawData (or someLayer.xmpMetadata.rawData). For structured edits load the AdobeXMPScript library (new ExternalObject("lib:AdobeXMPScript")), parse rawData with new XMPMeta(rawData), change properties, serialize() and assign the string back to rawData.

key_members.name: rawData
key_members.use: the whole XMP packet as XML text; read or replace

key_members.name: parent
key_members.use: the Document or Layer it belongs to

gotchas: the harvested class description (a Camera Raw .xmp sidecar) undersells it: Document.xmpMetadata is the whole embedded packet and Camera Raw settings are one part of it
assigning malformed XML to rawData throws or damages metadata: edit through XMPMeta, not string replacement
layer XMP is private to that layer and does not show in File Info (unverified)
nothing reaches disk until the document is saved
cards.source: ps_api_04 agent (omv + COM typelib harvest + app knowledge)
